keyCharacteristics: Use the overlay's lyric renderer and the active preset's own fonts, colors and motion for the sample.
Retain standard keyboard navigation, access labels and focus indicators.
narrative.overview: The first view opens the active preset. At a typical desktop size, the sample occupies most of the window. The inspector scrolls independently so changing a control keeps the preview in sight.

components.description: Restarts the lyric sample from the preview toolbar.
components.css: .ds-replay { font: 14px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; background: #2d2d2d; color: white; padding: 5px 9px; border: 1px solid #333; border-radius: 4px } .ds-replay:hover { background: #383838 } .ds-replay:active { background: #252525 } .ds-replay:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid white }
components.name: Replay preview

components.description: Selects the preset shown in the editor.
components.css: .ds-preset { display: grid; gap: 3px; color: white; font: 14px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", sans-serif } .ds-preset select { color-scheme: dark; padding: 5px 9px; border: 1px solid #333; border-radius: 4px; color: white; background: #2d2d2d; font: inherit } .ds-preset select:hover { background: #383838 } .ds-preset select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid white }
components.name: Preset selector

components.css: .ds-section { background: #262626; color: white; border-radius: 4px; font: 14px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; color-scheme: dark } .ds-section summary { padding: 12px; background: #2b2b2b; cursor: pointer } .ds-section label { display: grid; gap: 5px; padding: 14px } .ds-section summary:hover { background: #333 } .ds-section :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid white }
components.html: <details class="ds-section" open><summary>Motion</summary><label>Maximum tilt (degrees)<input type="range" min="0" max="15" value="0"></label></details>
components.name: Preset sections

components.description: Presets, Now playing, and Settings share the window header.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; background: #202020; color: white; font: 14px "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", sans-serif } .ds-tabs span { padding: 8px } .ds-tabs [aria-current] { background: #2b2b2b; border-radius: 5px 5px 0 0 }
components.name: Settings tabs

components.description: Illustration of the preview stage. The native editor uses the active preset and the overlay renderer.
components.css: .ds-stage { display: grid; place-items: center; min-height: 160px; text-align: center; padding: 12px; color: #f6efff; background: linear-gradient(152deg,#172f34 0%,#2c4f51 52%,#1a343b 53%,#112129 100%); font: 32px Impact, sans-serif }
components.name: Lyric sample
